senses.gloss:
m. (-थं)
A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, a flock.
f. (-थी)
A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
E.
यु to mix, थक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.

m. (-थः)
A large elephant, the leader of a wild herd.
E.
यूथ a multitude, (of elephants,) and नाथ lord.

m. (-पः)
The leader of a wild herd of elephants.
E.
यूथ a herd, and प who protects: see the last.

m. (-ष्टः)
An elephant turned out or driven from a herd.
E.
यूथ the herd, and भ्रष्ट expelled.

adv.
Gregariously, in flocks.
E.
यूथ, and शसि aff.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
2 Globe amaranth.
E.
यूथी the jasmine, कन् aff., fem. form.
